title: Native Goal Runtime and Assistant Chat Goal Mode
source_context: Retrospective planning ledger created from the Goal Mode design conversation. It captures native Goal runtime behavior, invisible Chain Wizard/internal goals, visible assistant-chat Goal Mode UI, weak-model safety, parallel child goals/subagents, sharded document handling, attachment preservation, completion certification, and compile boundaries. This is a conversational design/spec ledger, not a Goal run and not canonical Plans.
notes: Ready for explicit compile to canonical Plans. Do not include meta commentary or old prompt methods as product direction; include retired prompt-packet/D2 material only as negative constraints where needed.
